positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: My work focuses on making large language model systems more reliable by connecting model behavior to trusted, structured, and verifiable sources of information. Before that, I spent several years working on Knowledge Graph composition, building systems for representing, combining, and serving structured knowledge at scale.

honors.title: Outstanding Graduate Award

honors.title: La Caixa Fellowship
honors.description: La Caixa Fellowship is one of the best and most prestigious fellowships in Spain. La Caixa (Spain's third largest financial institution) offers 50 2-year sponsorships to pursue graduate studies in North America, based on academic merits.

projects.title: Wideband Transimpedance Amplifier
projects.description: Designed and characterized transistor level transimpedance amplifier using 130nm technology in Cadence Virtuoso (74dBΩ gain and 3.7GHz bandwidth).

projects.title: 32-bit Asynchronous microprocessor
projects.description: Design of a 32-bit RISC asynchronous microprocessor for EE 181b (VLSI design laboratory)
